messages.subject: updated Jacobian-needed message and conditions
parts:
I pushed an update with tests to change the message when
a non-linear transform of a parameter is detected.

This removes all the false positives for using linear
functions and operatos, changes the message to recommend
increment_log_prob instead of lp__ fiddle.

I included tests.

It's still not perfect because now there's the possibility
that it will not signal the warning when a local variable
is used if it's not explicitly transformed on the left-hand-side.
I really don't see how to get around that.

- Bob
